title: Android API26 captured physical mouse and trackpad motion source separation with historical batch
hypothesis: The Android capture callback previously interpreted every captured ACTION_MOVE via getX/getY and only the final sample. Relative mouse uses SOURCE_MOUSE_RELATIVE getX/getY, whereas captured SOURCE_TOUCHPAD uses absolute getX/getY and AXIS_RELATIVE_X/Y for movement. Missing history loses batched movement and may jerk the camera.
test_commands: private ilspycmd 11.2.0.10050 original and guarded Python exact-site rewrite
negative_controls: Uncaptured SOURCE_MOUSE=8194 is ignored; SOURCE_TOUCHSCREEN=4098 ignored; unknown and invalid sources ignored.
Only SOURCE_MOUSE_RELATIVE=131076 uses relative getX/Y; SOURCE_TOUCHPAD=1048584 uses AXIS_RELATIVE_X=27/Y=28, never absolute touchpad getX/Y.
ACTION_MOVE only; scroll and button events return false, preserving Unity's original handlers.
Batched events include getHistoricalX/Y or getHistoricalAxisValue before current sample; maximum 64 historical records per Android event to bound JNI work.
Zero, nonfinite and >10000-delta rejected before enabling relative-axis override.
Original ZIP2 DLL SHA and exact direct legacy camera axis count (4+4+2) must match; original meta/GUID and save untouched.
timeline_note: Earlier intermediate commits failed at missing PhysicalMouseMotionSource.cs in sparse-checkout before workflow list update; corrected workflow commit f9782c9 passed CI42121540200 and final policy commit 868eac passed CI42121598304.
limitations: Static source checks and managed compile do not prove Android JNI event source/relative coordinate behavior on actual Poco F5 Pro.
History >64 is deliberately passed to legacy handling rather than consuming a partial packet; requires device frequency evidence before tuning.
Pointer focus, game menu pointer, Android OS navigation bars, external wheel/buttons and same-SHA world/save regression remain untested.
Original playable world/save/reopen owner confirmation relates only to signed artifact run42058825739 SHA e9c358eda0; no new APK produced.
next_step: When coordinated T5 signed diagnostic APK is available, validate physical USB/Bluetooth mouse SOURCE_MOUSE_RELATIVE/trackpad on target Android device, continuous camera turn, capture loss/regrant, safe menu cursor/bars, wheel/buttons/touch and world/save/reopen; log native observed source kind without collecting raw events or input payload.
